zh: 我不认为自己世事练达。我曾经是，现在依然是个探索者，但我不再去星辰或书本里寻找知识，而是开始倾听内心血液的沸腾。
en: I do not consider myself worldly-wise. I was, and still am, a seeker — but I no longer search among the stars or in books; I have begun to listen to the blood whispering in my veins.
Be patient toward all that is unsolved in your heart and try to love the questions themselves.

zh: 不知周之梦为蝴蝶与，蝴蝶之梦为周与。
en: I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly dreaming I am a man.
Attention is the beginning of devotion.
